svg.title: MCP security gateway, the enforced path
svg.desc: Three cedar workload identities call one in-process gateway. The gateway checks token, audience, registry, catalog, policy, and approval, then mints a 60-second delegated credential. Two MCP servers expose four tools. Project 1 commit b1294e2 is a documented contract and was not contacted. Six integration gates are not-run. Price none.
svg.text: Stand-in client. Runtime was not started.
apply is high risk and sensitive
Third cedar identity. Demo count is 3.
A miss returns a reason, writes audit, and leaves the mock uncalled.
OPA is not the grant clock
Minted value is a new token
Endpoints are in-process. The mock accepts only a delegated credential for its own audience.
Documented JSON. The lab does not import its packages and does not dial it.
MCP_CONTROL_PLANE_URL is unset. Project 1 was not contacted. A set value is blocked and is not copied into the reason.
Protected calls during these stops stay at zero.
SYN-AGENT-BIRCH on SYN-TENANT-BIRCH is the cross-tenant stop only. The demo agent count is 3.
Not-run gates: control-plane, OIDC, local Docker, Kubernetes, OTLP, customer deployment. Spans stay in memory.
Lab clock 2026-11-12T15:00:00Z. Grant TTL 300 seconds. Downstream credential 60 seconds. Caller token TTL 1 hour. Price none.
